episodes.synopsis: Now that the Unova League is over, our heroes contemplate what the future holds, while a new friend helps them deal with a blast from the past!
episodes.title: New Places... Familiar Faces!

episodes.synopsis: On a ship heading to meet Professor Cedric Juniper at the White Ruins, our heroes are introduced to a young man with an unusual gift and an equally unusual point of view!
episodes.title: The Name's N!

episodes.synopsis: After arriving in Aspertia City at the request of Professor Juniper, our heroes pay a visit to one of the most unusual Gyms they've ever seen!
episodes.title: There's a New Gym Leader in Town!

episodes.synopsis: Continuing their journey to the White Ruins, our heroes encounter a mysterious organization with a sinister plot!
episodes.title: Team Plasma's Pokémon Power Plot!

episodes.synopsis: As our heroes continue their journey to the White Ruins, they come across a Mareep ranch with some fog and leadership issues!
episodes.title: The Light of Floccesy Ranch!

episodes.synopsis: Team Plasma is on the move, and so is N!
episodes.title: Saving Braviary!

episodes.synopsis: Arriving in Virbank City, our heroes and N encounter another group of heroes with some surprising results!
episodes.title: The Pokémon Harbor Patrol!

episodes.synopsis: After discovering a festival celebrating the sights and sounds of the Kanto region, Ash reunites with an old friend, who shows what real staying power is all about!
episodes.title: The Fires of a Red-Hot Reunion!

episodes.synopsis: Team Plasma is determined to execute its evil plans, but our heroes and N have other ideas!
episodes.title: Team Plasma's Pokémon Manipulation!

episodes.synopsis: As our heroes continue their journey to the White Ruins, they learn startling secrets about N and Team Plasma!
episodes.title: Secrets from Out of the Fog!

episodes.synopsis: As Team Plasma's mission to control Pokémon continues, Team Rocket's mission takes aim at Team Plasma!
episodes.title: Meowth, Colress and Team Rivalry!

episodes.synopsis: As our heroes unite with Professor Cedric Juniper at the White Ruins, it soon becomes obvious that they're not the only ones on a quest for information about Reshiram!
episodes.title: Ash and N: A Clash of Ideals!

episodes.synopsis: As Team Plasma's plan to steal the Light Stone unfolds, our heroes and their friends are doing everything they can to stop it!
episodes.title: Team Plasma and the Awakening Ceremony!

episodes.synopsis: As the evil plan to control Reshiram continues to unfold, the survival of the world lies in Team Plasma's defeat. But can they be defeated?!
episodes.title: What Lies Beyond Truth and Ideals!
